blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Globe Telecom Inc. has generated P1.2 billion in benefits, including additional revenue and cost savings through its in-house artificial intelligence (AI) investments. In a statement, the Ayala-backed telco said its generative AI and AI-machine learning initiatives yielded a 2.8-times return on investment based on its initial enterprise-wide measurement. READ: Globe harnesses AI to drive operational efficiency More than P825 million of the total came from incremental revenue generated by AI-powered commercial and customer initiatives. The telco has used AI to tailor customer offers and experiences across Globe Rewards, roaming, lending, and postpaid services. Another P368 million came from cost […]...
